ios.desc:
Relive your life's soundtrack with MemoKit.
Forget just writing down memories - MemoKit lets you relive them with the power of music. We all have songs that instantly transport us back to a special time. MemoKit captures that magic by letting you connect your most cherished experiences to the music that defined them.
Add a memory, pick the song, and watch it come alive again.  Browse your photos, revisit descriptions, and let the music wash over you as you're transported back to that special moment.

Here's what makes MemoKit special:
* Music-Triggered Memories: Unleash the power of music to unlock vivid details and emotions.
* Multi-Sensory Experience: Combine photos, descriptions, and music for a richer, more immersive way to relive memories.
* Effortless Capturing: Save memories on the go with quick and easy entry.
* Personalized Reminders: Stay connected to your memories with timely reminders to relive special moments and add new ones.

MemoKit: Because memories deserve to be more than just words!
